title: Binance Earn Introduces Discount Buy
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Terms and conditions apply.  Fellow Binancians, Binance Earn  is thrilled to introduce  Discount Buy , a high-yield product that enables savvy users to  buy crypto below the market price at the subscription time  or  earn fixed APR rewards  depending on market movement.  Discount Buy is ideal for users looking to accumulate crypto (e.g., BTC, ETH) in low-volatility markets, with an automated way to set target entry prices and earn potential rewards, all without the need for constant market monitoring. How It Works When subscribing to Discount Buy, users need to choose the key settings, such as Target Buy Price, Knockout Price, APR, and Settlement Date. On settlement, one of three outcomes occurs based on the Settlement Price: Scenario 1: 100% Principal Purchases  If the Settlement Price ≤ Target Buy Price, you will buy crypto with 100% of your investment at the Target Buy Price  Scenario 2: 50% Principal Purchases  If the Target Buy Price < Settlement Price < Knockout Price, you will buy crypto with 50% of your investment at the Target Buy Price Scenario 3: No Purchases, Receive Knockout APR Rewards If the Settlement Price ≥ Knockout Price, you will receive your full investment back along with APR rewards To learn more, please refer to this Blog:  Binance Discount Buy – Here's How You Can Buy Crypto Below Market Price or Earn Rewards .  Promotion: Subscribe to Earn an Additional 10% Discount on Crypto Purchases Promotion Period:  2025-07-29 08:00 (UTC) to 2025-08-12 23:59 (UTC) To celebrate the launch of Discount Buy, Binance Earn is offering an exclusive promotion. Eligible users who  opt in on the activity page  and subscribe to Discount Buy during the Promotion Period will receive an  additional   10% discount on top of their selected discount rate upon successful crypto purchases. Subscriptions with an accumulative volume between  10 USDT and 3,000 USDT  and with settlement dates  before 2025-08-12 23:59 (UTC)  will qualify for this reward. Promotion Reward Calculation: For example, a user subscribed to BTC/USDT Discount Buy with 600 USDT. At the subscription time, the market price is $120,000. The user chooses the product with a Target Buy Price of $114,000, a 5% discount on $120,000. On the settlement date,  Scenario 1: 100% Principal Purchases If the Settlement Price ≤ $114,000, the user buys crypto with 600 USDT and can earn the promotion reward. The additional discount rate is 5% * 10% = 0.5%. Therefore, the promotion reward = effective buy amount * 0.5% = 600 USDT * 0.5% = 3 USDT. Scenario 2: 50% Principal Purchases If $114,000 < Settlement Price < Knockout Price, the user buys crypto with 300 USDT(= 600 USDT * 50%) and can earn the promotion reward. The promotion reward = effective buy amount in USDT * 0.5% = 300 * 0.5% = 1.5 USDT. Scenario 3: No Purchases and Receive Knockout APR Rewards If the Settlement Price ≥ Knockout Price, the user receives 600 USDT and APR rewards. The promotion reward does  not  apply in this scenario, as no crypto was purchased. How to Subscribe to Discount Buy Log in to your Binance account. If you are using the App, tap the [Discount Buy] icon. If you are on the website, go to [Earn] > [Advanced Earn] > [ Discount Buy ]. Select from the available product options, each with a preset Target Buy Price, Knockout Price, APR, and Settlement Date. Enter the subscription amount. If this is your first time subscribing to Discount Buy, you will be asked to complete a quiz.  Please read the Terms & Conditions carefully before subscribing and acknowledge that you cannot edit, cancel, or redeem your subscription before the settlement once you subscribe. Once you have successfully subscribed, you can view your subscription by going to [Orders] > [Earn History] > [Discount Buy]. Subscribe Now!
